scattering.source: IceCube SPICE-Lea model (arXiv:1301.5361), effective scattering at ~400 nm depth-averaged

symmetric.description: Rayleigh-like: reuse water functional form with ice-tuned coefficients

asymmetric.description: Forward Mie (ice dust): alpha_asym = P6 * (1 + P7/lambda^4 * (lambda - P8)^2)

absorption.source: IceCube SPICE-Lea model depth-averaged, placeholder using water functional form
absorption.description: alpha_abs = P0*P1/lambda^4 + C(lambda); same form as water with ice-tuned P0
